recognize_zh: 骨小樑下方的骨髓中可見鬆散的類上皮組織球聚集，夾雜大小不一的脂肪空泡（lipogranuloma）與一個多核巨細胞；右上方另有一個邊界圓、外圍帶淡嗜伊紅同心環的肉芽腫，符合外圈纖維環（fibrin ring）肉芽腫。
features: Bone trabecula at top with adjacent cellular marrow
Loose aggregates of epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm interspersed with lipid vacuoles (lipogranulomas)
Multinucleated giant cell within the histiocytic aggregate
Well-circumscribed round granuloma at right with a concentric eosinophilic outer rim (fibrin ring)
Residual hematopoiesis with megakaryocytes and maturing precursors at the periphery
No caseous necrosis or atypical large lymphoid cells identified
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a bony trabecula with adjacent cellular marrow containing loose aggregates of epithelioid histiocytes admixed with variably sized lipid vacuoles, consistent with lipogranulomas, including a multinucleated giant cell. At the right is a well-circumscribed granuloma with a concentric eosinophilic outer rim, consistent with a fibrin-ring granuloma. Residual trilineage hematopoiesis is present, and no caseous necrosis or atypical lymphoid infiltrate is identified. Findings are consistent with a granulomatous marrow reaction including lipogranulomas and fibrin-ring granuloma, compatible with an infectious etiology such as EBV in this clinical context; stains for organisms are recommended.

ddx.vs: These produce compact epithelioid granulomas, often with caseous necrosis, and organisms demonstrable by AFB or GMS stains and culture.
Sarcoid granulomas are tight, non-necrotizing, non-lipid-associated epithelioid granulomas without fibrin rings, diagnosed by exclusion with systemic findings.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma with granulomatous reaction
ddx.vs: Hodgkin involvement requires CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells, typically with fibrosis, which are not evident here.
